timing: Explicit operationalization after first-epoch scores were observed, before fixed-budget endpoints; not described as an entirely blind preregistration. No tolerance fitted to observed gains.
source: User requires NC/DAC/TTC nondegradation and fixed-reference safety accounting.

eligibility.fixed_reference_safe_set_any_seed_violat: no larger than matched SFT evaluation count

selection: Among empirically eligible saved DEV checkpoints choose highest mean PDMS; otherwise retain SFT and report no qualifying improved policy. Always report registered final-budget endpoints separately.
uncertainty: Eligibility is an observed finite-seed engineering criterion, not a safety guarantee. Report log-cluster intervals and two separate training seeds.
second_training_seed_selection: Matched control and most supported completed research route after full original DEV, including a diagnostic route if no empirically safe policy qualifies. Do not replace a failed safety result with an intermediate maximum.
navtest: After checkpoint/route lock only; never fit this rule or search on Navtest.
